Add only the requested number of extra sessions within supplied availability, resource/participant access and all limits; a maximum is not a target. CDC's general recommendation for children and adolescents aged 6–17 is at least 60 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous activity each day. Most should be aerobic, with vigorous aerobic activity on at least three days each week. Muscle- and bone-strengthening activity are each included on at least three days weekly as part of the daily activity, rather than as separate additional sixty-minute blocks. Choices should be varied, age-appropriate and enjoyable.

Population-level activity guidance for ages 6–17. The daily amount covers the activity mix; the weekly components do not require separate additional sixty-minute sessions. This is not an individualized basketball workload or an adopted project planning threshold.
